d:
The sixth studio recorded single, written, sung and composed by is here!
talks about a guy who remembers the things that he and the girl he can’t be with used to talk about and how these “sweet” memories act as a lullaby and help him go to sleep at night.
This song was written to be used as a word bank for my song "Riha". I randomly played it a few times on my live streams and people really liked it, rather loved it and asked me to get it recorded. So here is Mishri...
